where: Vendimi i Këshillit të Ministrave nr. 584, datë 8.10.2021 (state of emergency in electricity supply), pika 5
what: The state of emergency ran out on 15 April 2022 and again on 30 June 2023 and was each time extended by a decision adopted after the end date (VKM 256/2022 and VKM 449/2023), so it had ended from 16 to 28 April 2022 and from 1 to 27 July 2023 (two flags).

where: Vendimi i Këshillit të Ministrave nr. 98, datë 27.1.2009 (sale of the land of privatised state enterprises and properties), pika 3
what: The deadline to buy the land, 31 May 2009, was extended to 30 June 2010 by VKM nr. 923, datë 2.9.2009, which took effect only on publication on 6 October 2009, so from 1 June to 5 October 2009 the deadline had passed.

where: Ligji nr. 10418, datë 21.4.2011 (legalisation of capital and forgiveness of part of tax and customs debts), neni 35
what: The right ended on 31 March 2012 and was extended to 31 March 2013 by Ligji nr. 154/2013, which took effect only on 22 June 2013, after its own new date had also passed.

The COVID-19 notification route for increases in the capacity of waste storage sites covered increases "until 30.09.2020" and was extended to 30 April 2021 only from 8 January 2021 (BGBl. I Nr. 8/2021), with no retroactive wording; long spent.

The special COVID-19 rules for hearings and taking evidence in tax proceedings applied until the end of 31 December 2020 and were extended to 31 March 2021 only from 8 January 2021 (BGBl. I Nr. 3/2021), leaving 1 to 7 January 2021 without a basis; long spent.

The Landeshauptmann still sends supply concepts "for the report under § 52 Abs. 1", which BGBl. I Nr. 150/2021 repealed from 28 July 2021 (a reference to a repealed placeholder, not reviewed by the model).

The in-force rule of BGBl. I Nr. 150/2021 cites the amendment and the Erneuerbaren-Ausbau-Gesetz as "BGBl. I Nr. x/y", a drafting placeholder never replaced, four times in two paragraphs (found by reading).

§ 47 Abs. 1 lit. d is repealed "with the entry into force of the Finanz-Organisationsreformgesetz BGBl. I Nr. xx/2019", an act published as BGBl. I Nr. 104/2019 with several commencement dates; the RIS notes that 1 July 2020 is "obviously" meant (found by reading).

Art. 1362 still cites art. 738, repealed by L 1992-08-03/31 from 1 January 1993, a real reference to an article repealed long ago found among the references to repealed placeholders, which the model does not review.
Controllers are still made subject to Article 44(8) of the law, but Article 71(IV) of Law 13,506/2017 repealed the whole of Article 44 from 14 November 2017 with no rule redirecting the reference.

Provisional Measure 181/2004 moved Eletrobras's deadline to 31 May 2004 and the conversion law, Law 10,889/2004, extended it to 30 June only from 28 June with no retroactive wording, so from 1 to 27 June 2004 the deadline had passed.
A real gap chosen rather than overlooked: the new paragraph was vetoed and took effect only once the veto was overridden in July 2023, so from 1 January to 18 July 2023 it was not in force.

A real gap chosen rather than overlooked: the exemption from withholding on air tickets bought with the Federal Government Payment Card expired at the end of 2017 and the two provisional measures that restored it lost effect.

A real gap chosen rather than overlooked: the one-point Cofins-Importação surcharge expired in 2020 and Law 14,288/2021 restored it only from 1 April 2022, as Article 195(6) of the Constitution requires.

where: Инструкция № 8121з-282 от 15 март 2018 г. (service cards in the Ministry of the Interior, ДВ бр. 26/2018), § 4, ал. 2
what: It let the 2016 hologram stickers be used until 30 June 2018, but the instruction it replaced allowed them only until 31 December 2017 and the new one took effect on 23 March 2018, so for 81 days no rule allowed them.

where: Tax Statute (Estatuto Tributario, Decree 624 of 1989), Article 74-1, paragraph 3
what: The paragraph still excludes projects "that opt for what Articles 158-1 and 256 provide", although Law 2277 of 2022 (Art. 96) repealed Article 158-1 from 13 December 2022 without amending Article 74-1; a minor slip, as the reference to Article 256 still stands.

Health providers seeking accreditation could draw on the university-hospital stamp levy "until 31 December 2021", and Law 2333 of 2023 moved the date to 2026 only from 25 September 2023; a real gap that the extending act acknowledged by guaranteeing the "retroactivity" of the funds not paid while it lapsed.

where: Zakon o sudovima (NN 150/2005), čl. 79, in the official consolidated text NN 122/2010
what: Point 13 still cited Article 102 after Article 22 of NN 116/2010 deleted it from 21 October 2010, a reference left behind by the amendment until a new Zakon o sudovima (NN 28/2013) replaced the act.
Act No. 73/2025 Coll. repealed §§ 56 to 56b and moved their content to §§ 52e to 52n, but seven places still cite § 56 or § 56a.

where: Zákon č. 382/2021 Sb., čl. II bod 18
what: Act No. 19/2023 Coll. extended a transitional deadline of 31 December 2022 only from 24 January 2023, so for 23 days the rule had lapsed.

where: Vyhláška č. 451/2000 Sb., the annexes listing permitted feed additives
what: Decree No. 343/2001 Coll. extended additives permitted until 30 September 2001 only from 4 October 2001, so for three days they were not permitted (11 flags).

where: Zákon o investičních společnostech a investičních fondech (248/1992 Sb.), § 35l(2)
what: Act No. 39/2004 Coll. moved the end of 2003, the latest date to which the Securities Commission could extend a fund's conversion, to the end of 2004 only from 5 February 2004.

It extended Legislative Decree No. 605 of 1993 (former combatants' capacity under the housing programme) to 30 September 1994 after the previous extension ran out on 30 June, but took effect only on publication on 16 August 1994 with no retroactive wording, so from 1 July to 15 August 1994 Decree No. 605 had no effect.

where: Legislative Decree No. 54 of 1994, Art. 1 and recital III
what: It extended Legislative Decree No. 403 of 1992 (former combatants' capacity under the land transfer programme) to 30 September 1994 after it expired on 30 June, but took effect on publication on 17 August 1994 with no retroactive wording, so from 1 July to 16 August 1994 the former combatants lacked that capacity (2 flags).

It extended the time limit in Article 107 of the Environment Act, which expired on 13 May 2000, but took effect on publication on 16 May 2000 with no retroactive wording, leaving a two-day gap on 14 and 15 May.
The derogation letting titres-restaurant pay for any food ran until 31 December 2024 and was extended by Law No. 2025-56 only from 23 January 2025, leaving 1 to 22 January 2025 uncovered.

The aid for the regional and local periodical press lapsed three times, from 1 January to 5 December 2019, from 1 January to 6 May 2023 and from 1 January to 9 August 2026, before each late extension.
The control and distribution regime for energy and petroleum products ran until 31 December 2017 and was revived by Decree No. 2022-409 only from 25 March 2022.

where: Décret n° 2017-913 of 9 May 2017, Article 22, and the arrêté of 13 September 2017, Article 46
what: Chapter III of the decree on the Paris gaming clubs experiment lapsed from 1 January 2021 to 8 November 2022 and from 1 January to 26 February 2025, and the implementing arrêté from 1 January 2023 to 26 February 2025.

where: Loi n° 2005-1720, Article 119, II, and Loi n° 2025-127, Article 150
what: Two State guarantees that could be granted until 31 December 2025 were extended by the finance law for 2026 only from 21 February 2026, so neither could be granted from 1 January to 20 February 2026.

where: Arrêté of 1 April 2026 approving the règlement of the invalidity and death insurance scheme for the self-employed, Article 33 of the règlement
what: Article 33 requires the conditions of Articles 36 and 37, but Article 37 has read only "Abrogé." since the règlement took effect on 5 April 2026 (found among references to repealed placeholders, not reviewed by the model).

where: Gesetz zur Verbesserung der personellen Struktur beim Bundeseisenbahnvermögen und in den Postnachfolgeunternehmen (BEDBPStruktG), § 4 Abs. 1
what: Retirement on application for civil servants of the postal successor companies ran "until 31 December 2024" and was extended to 2026 only by an act of 22 December 2025, with no retroactive wording in the texts this repository holds, so for almost all of 2025 there was no retirement on application under § 4.
The deemed approval of charging points of distribution system operators ended on 31 December 2024 and was extended to 31 December 2026 by an act of 21 February 2025, after it had ended.

where: Verordnung zur Verlängerung des Zeitraums für Vereinbarungen zur wirtschaftlichen Sicherung der Vorsorge- und Rehabilitationseinrichtungen, §§ 1 and 2 (two flags)
what: Two periods for preventive and rehabilitation facilities ran to 19 March 2022 and were extended by an ordinance promulgated on 11 April 2022, taking effect the day after promulgation, so from 20 March to at least 11 April 2022 the period did not run.
Since Art. 29 G v. 6.5.2024 repealed §§ 2 to 3f, paragraph 2a was left standing and deals only with repealed provisions; without effect, but not cleaned up.

where: Allgemeine Waffengesetz-Verordnung (AWaffV), § 34 Nr. 11; not reviewed by the model
what: The administrative offence still points to § 12 Abs. 2 Satz 2 AWaffV, which reads "(weggefallen)" since 1 September 2020 when its content moved to § 27a WaffG, so the prohibition no longer carries a fine.

where: Börsengesetz, § 50 Abs. 2 Nr. 22; not reviewed by the model
what: Art. 21 G v. 4.2.2026 repealed § 26e and in the same change renumbered § 50 Abs. 2, carrying over unchanged an offence that cites § 26e Satz 1.

where: Verordnung über die Erteilung von Inbetriebnahmegenehmigungen für das Eisenbahnsystem (EIGV), § 41 Abs. 2 Nr. 5; not reviewed by the model
what: The offence cites § 38 Absatz 3 Satz 1, but § 38 (the national vehicle register) has read "(weggefallen)" since 16 June 2021.

where: Energiesteuer-Durchführungsverordnung (EnergieStV), § 111 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 and 17; not reviewed by the model
what: The offences still point to § 101 Absatz 4, although § 101 has read "(weggefallen)" since 1 January 2025 and § 111 was amended in other items on 1 January 2026.

where: Futtermittelverordnung, § 40 Abs. 1 Nr. 1; not reviewed by the model
what: V v. 11.4.2024 repealed § 4 (labelling of certain feeds) and amended § 40 in the same change, but left "§ 4" in the offence.

where: Verordnung über die Schutz- und Sicherheitshäfen, die Häfen der Deutschen Marine und der Bundespolizei (SchSiHafV), § 42 Nr. 13, 21, 31, 33, 34 and 35; not reviewed by the model
what: Six offence items point wholly or partly to §§ 26 to 30, which already read "(weggefallen)" in this repository's first copy of 10 June 2019.

where: Tierschutz-Nutztierhaltungsverordnung (TierSchNutztV), § 44 Abs. 1 Nr. 44b; not reviewed by the model
what: The offence cites "§ 35 Absatz 7" although § 35 has only five paragraphs and the duty described is in § 35a Abs. 7, so under Art. 103 Abs. 2 GG the reference as it stands cannot carry the fine.

where: Weinverordnung (WeinV), § 52 Abs. 2 Nr. 2; not reviewed by the model
what: The change of 2 September 2026 repealed § 47 and amended § 52 Abs. 1 but not Abs. 2 Nr. 2, so a criminal provision points to a repealed provision.

where: 予防接種法施行令 (Cabinet Order No. 197 of 1948), supplementary provisions of Cabinet Order No. 17 of 1977, Article 2
what: The reading-in rule still quotes "四千四百二十万円" in Article 17(4)(ii), although since 1 April 2023 that article has read 45,300,000 yen (49,500,000 yen today) and none of the later orders changed the quotation.

where: 国民年金法施行規則 (Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare No. 12 of 1960), Article 69
what: Article 69 still suspends payment when "the documents under Article 51-5" are not submitted, an article removed from 1 April 2024 (by Ministerial Ordinance No. 30 of 2024 according to e-Gov).

where: 温室効果ガス算定排出量等の集計の方法等を定める省令, Article 7
what: Article 7 still rewrites words in Article 3, which has read only "削除" (deleted) since 1 April 2022, a leftover found among the references to repealed placeholders, which the model does not review.

where: Stipendiengesetz (StipG), LR 416.0, Art. 21 Abs. 3, Art. 24 Abs. 2 and Art. 37 (3 flags)
what: LGBl. 2012 Nr. 263 repealed Art. 23 and Art. 32 Abs. 2, but the three provisions that cite them were not changed.

where: Bezügegesetz, LR 174.60, Art. 6g Abs. 1 Bst. b
what: LGBl. 2025 Nr. 25 abolished the presidents' flat allowance of Art. 6e from 1 January 2026, but Art. 6g still sets when that allowance is settled.

where: Verordnung über die fachliche Eignung des Gefahrgutbeauftragten, LR 741.622, Art. 19b Abs. 1
what: Art. 19b still names Art. 9, which was repealed by LGBl. 2023 Nr. 32.
Art. 6 still names Art. 14, repealed by LGBl. 2024 Nr. 227, as one of the three articles that apply.

where: Betäubungsmittelgesetz (BMG), LR 812.120, Art. 24 Abs. 1 Bst. b
what: A criminal provision still cites Art. 11, repealed by LGBl. 2015 Nr. 25.

where: Gesetz über die Invalidenversicherung (IVG), LR 831.20, Art. 60bis Abs. 3
what: Abs. 3 still refers to the reduction of children's pensions under Art. 63bis, repealed by LGBl. 2016 Nr. 231.
Art. 7 still refers to tasks under Art. 5, repealed by LGBl. 2016 Nr. 222, although LGBl. 2026 Nr. 223 changed Art. 7 and left the reference.
Six of the eight articles Art. 26 names were repealed by the Strafrechtsanpassungsgesetz (LGBl. 1988 Nr. 38); harmless, as the list only names offences that no longer exist.

where: Übernahmegesetz (ÜbG), LR 954.4, Art. 23 Abs. 1 Bst. d; found by reading, not by a detector
what: Bst. d stands twice, word for word, in Lilex's consolidated text, likely a slip in the consolidation rather than in the Landesgesetzblatt.
It still has the curators note the sum paid "conformément à l'article 480", but the law of 7 August 2023 modernising insolvency law repealed Article 480 without amending Article 563.

where: Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364), article 48; a dead fine
what: Article 48 still sets a penalty for failing to comply with article 39, which Act XII of 2014 deleted in the same Part that amended article 48 itself.

where: Merchant Shipping Act (Cap. 234), article 274; a reference to a repealed placeholder
what: Article 274 still applies article 229 to load line certificates, although Act I of 2025 deleted article 229.

where: Criminal Code (Cap. 9), article 40(a); a dead fine
what: Article 40 still applies article 36 to deaf-mutes aged fourteen to eighteen, although Act III of 2014 deleted article 36.

where: Ley para Regular las Actividades de las Sociedades Cooperativas de Ahorro y Préstamo, Article Three of the transitional provisions of the enacting decree (DOF 13-08-2009)
what: The time limit "until 31 December 2012" was moved to 31 March 2014 only by a decree in force from 5 January 2013, with no retroactive wording, so from 1 to 4 January 2013 the time limit had run out, though with no practical effect.

where: Ley General de Comunicación Social, Article 26, last paragraph
what: Since the decree published on 2 June 2023 it refers to "the principles set out in Article 5 Bis of this Law", an article the Supreme Court invalidated with the whole decree of 27 December 2022 with effect from 8 May 2023.

The power to designate railways as main railways ran until 1 January 2005, then 2008, then 2010, then 2013, and each extension took effect after the old date had passed (by 74, 486 and 936 days) without retroactive effect, so in between the power did not exist.

where: Wet aanvullende bepalingen verwerking persoonsgegevens in de zorg, art. 15n
what: Art. 15n, inserted in 2025, refers to "artikel 16, tweede lid", but the act has had no art. 16 since 1 July 2017, so as published the reference points to nothing.

An order in council raised the maximum fine categories from 1 January 2022 but was published on 5 January 2022, although under art. 89(3) of the Constitution it cannot enter into force before publication (found among the flags the model did not review).
It still makes it an offence to fail to comply with "a notice referred to in section 184(1)", a section the Fire and Emergency New Zealand Act 2017 repealed from 1 July 2018.
It still fixes fines for offences under sections 224, 225 and 227, which the Local Government (Water Services) (Repeals and Amendments) Act 2025 repealed from 27 August 2025.
Two definitions still point to section 124, repealed by the same Act from 27 August 2025, which amended section 5 that day and left them.
It still lets the local authority restrict water supply "as provided for in section 193", repealed from 27 August 2025 by the same Act that amended section 182 that day.
It still refers to disqualification and waivers "under section 16", repealed by the Charities Amendment Act 2023 from 5 October 2023, whose rule is now in section 36B.
It still refers to orders "under section 60 or section 61", repealed by the Charities Amendment Act 2023 from 5 July 2024, and does not name the new appeal sections.
It still refers to the chief executive acting under section 124, repealed by the Residential Tenancies Amendment Act 2020 from 11 February 2021.
It still refers to the powers conferred by section 124, repealed from 11 February 2021, and kept the reference when amended on 28 October 2021.
It still applies "subject to section 277A", repealed by the Statutes Amendment Act 2022 from 30 November 2022.
It still requires a draft report "under section 149Q", repealed by the Resource Legislation Amendment Act 2017 from 19 April 2017, and kept it when amended from 1 July 2020.
It still gives a power "under section 69K", repealed from 22 January 2014 by the Act that amended section 69E that day.
It still gives a power "under section 80H", repealed from 22 January 2014 by the Act that amended section 80C that day.
Its definition still names section 80ZV, repealed by the Secondary Legislation Act 2021 from 28 October 2021, which amended section 80ZT that day; a definition only, nothing turns on it.
It still applies "sections 133AW and 133AX" to an amended methodology, although the Secondary Legislation Act 2021 repealed section 133AX and moved the duty to notify into section 133AV the same day.
It still describes "section 17(2)(a)", repealed on 1 October 2024, although section 9 has been amended three times since.

where: Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009), Article 159 bis (21)
what: It still applies Article 135 bis, which Royal Decree 118/2020 repealed when it put the same rule in a new Article 138, while the same decree replaced Article 159 bis (17) and left Article 159 bis (21) as it was.

Item 2, copied as it stood when Ley N° 7062/2023 rewrote Article 8, still refers to Articles 129b and 129c, which Ley N° 4788/2012 had repealed ten years earlier, so the rule applying Paraguayan criminal law to trafficking committed abroad refers to two articles that no longer exist.

where: Ley N° 861/1996, the General Banking Law, Article 79(f)
what: The ranking of subordinated bonds on liquidation refers to Article 131, which fell when Ley N° 2334/2003 replaced and repealed Chapters I to VI of Title X, and Ley N° 5787/2016 amended 38 provisions of the law but left Article 79 alone.

where: Ley N° 1328/1998 on Copyright and Related Rights, Article 151; Ley N° 1294/1998 on Trademarks, Article 129; Ley N° 868/1981 on Industrial Designs, Article 28
what: Ley N° 5456/2015 rewrote Article 2 of Ley N° 4046/2010 and again declared repealed these three articles on appeals, which Ley N° 4798/2012 had re-enacted with new wording, so the 2015 law appears to repeal what had already been enacted again (the 2010 to 2013 gap itself was real and closed by the 2012 law).

where: Ley N° 5895/2017 setting transparency rules for companies with share capital, Article 3
what: The twenty-four-month time limit for exchanging bearer shares ran out on 10 October 2019, two days before Ley N° 6399/2019, which replaced it, took effect on 12 October, leaving a one-day empty period with no rule on the suspension of rights and fines the old text triggered.
Item 4 still ends guardianship "en el caso del artículo 580", but Decreto Legislativo 1384 repealed Article 580 in 2018, so the item refers to a case the Code no longer provides for.

Curatorship of the habitual drunkard and the drug addict still follows the rules of Articles 576, 577 and 578, but Article 578 was repealed by Decreto Legislativo 1384, and the text does not say whether court authorisation for placement is still needed.
The statutory curatorship of a convicted person is still conferred in the order of Article 569, which Decreto Legislativo 1384 repealed, so the Code no longer says who that curator is.

Interim curatorship of an absent or missing person's property still follows Articles 569 and 573 though Article 569 was repealed, of minor effect since Article 573 stands and the court appoints failing those called.

where: Kodeks spółek handlowych (Dz.U. 2000 nr 94 poz. 1037), art. 594 § 1 pkt 2
what: The Act of 30 August 2019 (Dz.U. 2019 poz. 1798) repealed art. 341 (the share register book, księga akcyjna) and in the same article gave art. 594 § 1 pkt 2 a new wording that still fines a management board member who does not keep the share register book in accordance with art. 341 § 1.

where: Federal Law No. 206-FZ of 21 July 2014 "О карантине растений", Article 28(3)(4)
what: Point 4 still refers to Article 8(3), although Federal Law No. 170-FZ of 11 June 2021 repealed Article 8 and at the same time reworded the opening words of Article 28(3), which looks like an oversight in the amendment (found by reading references to repealed articles, which the model does not review).

where: Law No. 94 of 7 August 2017 (extraordinary building amnesty), Article 33(8)
what: Decree-Law No. 135 of 5 September 2019 extended the time to apply for the amnesty to 30 September 2020 but left the remaining 50% payment due on 30 November 2019, which was moved only by Decree-Law No. 14 of 30 January 2020, 61 days after it had passed.

where: Act on the use of land in established allotment gardens (64/1997 Z. z.), § 7(1), § 10(1) and (2)
what: Act No. 57/2011 Z. z. deleted § 11, the compensation for the land, and replaced "§ 11" in § 12, but these three provisions still refer to the compensation in § 11.
Act No. 361/2015 Z. z. deleted §§ 131a to 132n from 1 July 2016, but § 114(3) still forbids "market manipulation under § 131a".

where: Fire and Rescue Service Act (315/2001 Z. z.), § 201a
what: The lending of ranks to former soldiers of the civil protection troops ended on 31 December 2003 and Act No. 180/2004 Z. z. extended it to 2004 only from 1 May 2004, so from 1 January to 30 April 2004 the rule did not apply.

where: Fire and Rescue Service Act (315/2001 Z. z.), § 205b(2)
what: The old uniforms counted as members' uniforms until 31 December 2003 and Act No. 180/2004 Z. z. extended this to 2004 only from 1 May 2004, leaving a gap from 1 January to 30 April 2004.

where: Act No. 567/1992 Zb. on budget rules (repealed since), § 32(2)
what: Act No. 172/1994 Z. z. moved the municipalities' deadline for converting municipal enterprises from 31 December 1993 to 31 December 1994 only from 20 July 1994, without retroactive effect.

where: Government Regulation No. 302/2003 Z. z. on the protection of animals during transport (repealed since), § 17(3)
what: Government Regulation No. 145/2005 Z. z. moved the hauliers' deadline for professional competence from 1 August 2004 to 1 September 2005 only from 15 April 2005, more than eight months after the old date.

where: Act No. 134/1992 Zb. on the state administration of air protection (repealed since), § 12(4)
what: Act No. 148/1994 Z. z. wrote into § 12(4), from 1 July 1994, that the authority decides "by 30 June 1993", a deadline that had passed a year before.

where: Texto refundido de la Ley del Impuesto sobre Sociedades (Royal Legislative Decree 4/2004), Additional Provision 14
what: The 21% withholding rate ran until 31 December 2013 and Royal Decree-law 1/2014 extended it only from 26 January 2014 with no retroactive wording, so from 1 to 25 January 2014 the rate was back at 19%.

Standard-definition broadcasting was allowed until 1 January 2023 and Royal Decree 16/2023 moved the date to 14 February 2024 only from 19 January 2023, leaving 2 to 18 January 2023 without cover (2 flags).

The brucellosis vaccination exception lapsed from 1 January to 16 June 2011 (Royal Decree 727/2011) and throughout 2015 (Royal Decree 71/2016 applies from 1 January 2016), although the 2008 extension had been made retroactive (2 flags).
A dead fine found outside the model review: the offence still names paragraph 6 of Article 58 ter, which Law 31/2022 left without content from 1 January 2023 without amending Article 63.

A real gap chosen rather than overlooked: after the Congress declined to validate Royal Decree-laws 9/2024 and 16/2025, no new suspension of evictions could be ordered from 23 to 29 January 2025 and from 28 January to 4 February 2026 (3 flags).
A real gap chosen rather than overlooked: after Royal Decree-law 16/2025 was not validated, landlords could make no compensation claim from 1 to 4 February 2026.
A real gap chosen rather than overlooked: after Royal Decree-law 9/2024 was not validated, foreign investments by EU and EFTA residents were not subject to authorisation from 23 to 29 January 2025.

where: Tababet ve Şuabatı San'atlarının Tarzı İcrasına Dair Kanun (1219), Article 68
what: Rewritten by Law No. 5728 in 2008, it still fines nurses who exceed the scope of practice shown in Article 64, which Law No. 6283 repealed in 1954.

where: Tababet ve Şuabatı San'atlarının Tarzı İcrasına Dair Kanun (1219), Article 55
what: It still fines midwives under Article 53, which Law No. 6514 repealed in 2014 without amending Article 55.
It still punishes breaches of Articles 72 and 73, which Law No. 7139 rewrote and repealed in 2018.

where: Law No. 6343 on veterinary practice, Article 67
what: It still fines breaches of Article 43, repealed in 1963 by Law No. 239; later laws replaced only the amount of the fine.

where: Sıvılaştırılmış Petrol Gazları (LPG) Piyasası Kanunu (5307), provisional Article 7
what: The cost difference owed to ceramics producers was to be paid by 31 March 2006, and Law No. 5522 moved the date to 31 March 2007 only from 24 June 2006, with no retroactive wording.
A reference left behind in the same act: it still cites Article 38, repealed in 1995.
A reference left behind in the same act: it cites Article 24, repealed in 1963.
A reference left behind in the same act: it cites the fund of Article 15, repealed in 2000.
